value_conditions.effect: Removes every tool whose annotation ReadOnlyHint!=true (inventory drops !IsReadOnly under readOnly). Eliminates all SINK tools (create_*/update_*/add_*_comment/merge_*/push_files/label_write/projects_write/actions_run_trigger/assign_copilot_*/gist writes), leaving only reads => package loses SINK and the SECRET+UNTRUSTED+SINK triple is broken. Read-only takes precedence over --tools.
value_conditions.default: absent => read-write: all write tools present.

value_conditions.syntax: --toolsets / GITHUB_TOOLSETS / X-MCP-Toolsets header / URL path /x/{toolset} (single) or /x/all
value_conditions.effect: Restricts enabled toolsets. Default (nil) = context,repos,issues,pull_requests,users,copilot. Selecting a subset removes the labels contributed only by omitted toolsets (e.g. a read-only-only toolset, or dropping repos/issues/pull_requests removes their SINK writes). 'all' enables every toolset.
value_conditions.default: absent => the six default toolsets above (README default list omits copilot but code marks copilot Default:true).
value_conditions.evidence: pkg/inventory/builder.go:322-374; pkg/github/tools.go:28-149 (Default:true metadata); pkg/github/tools_test.go:22-31 default expansion; pkg/http/handler.go:167-176 URL paths; docs/remote-server.md:122-137

value_conditions.effect: Best-effort content filter (NOT a security boundary): only issue_read(get)/pull_request_read(get,get_diff,get_files,get_commits) error, and issue_read/pull_request_read comment/review/sub-issue sub-methods drop items authored by users lacking push access (trusted bots github-actions[bot]/copilot exempt). It does NOT touch search_issues/list_issues/get_file_contents/get_discussion/get_gist/list_notifications/actions logs etc., so UNTRUSTED remains in the package. Does not change what the credential can read/write.
value_conditions.default: absent => no content filtering (UNTRUSTED fully present). HTTP header is an upper bound: cannot relax operator-set lockdown.
value_conditions.evidence: pkg/lockdown/lockdown.go:135-164 IsSafeContent, :109-111 trusted bots; pkg/github/issues.go:918-1191, pkg/github/pullrequests.go:187-594; README.md:1653-1692

value_conditions.effect: --tools is an additive allow-list bypassing toolset gating (still subject to read-only); with --tools and no --toolsets only those tools register. --exclude-tools removes named tools regardless of other settings (highest precedence). Either can drop specific SECRET/UNTRUSTED/SINK tools.

value_conditions.syntax: classic-PAT scope filtering (automatic) ; --insiders / GITHUB_INSIDERS / X-MCP-Insiders / /insiders ; --features / X-MCP-Features / ?features=
value_conditions.effect: Classic-PAT (ghp_) scopes auto-hide tools needing absent scopes (read-only public-repo tools always shown); fine-grained/App tokens => no filtering. Insiders and --features (allow-listed flags only) turn ON extra/granular tool variants (e.g. issues_granular swaps consolidated issue_write for single-field update_issue_* granular tools), changing which named tools appear but not the label union.
value_conditions.default: absent => no scope filtering unless a classic PAT is detected; insiders off; granular variants off (consolidated issue_write/update_pull_request/pull_request_review_write active).
value_conditions.evidence: pkg/github/feature_flags.go:44-71 AllowedFeatureFlags/InsidersFeatureFlags; internal/ghmcp/server.go:186,340-360 scope filtering; pkg/http/handler.go:178-200; docs/scope-filtering.md; docs/remote-server.md:60-137

notes: Snapshot covers ALL 121 tools; default toolsets (context,repos,issues,pull_requests,users,copilot) enable a subset. default_enabled reflects: in a default toolset AND not feature-gated-off. Granular issue/PR tools, get_file_blame, find_duplicate, issue_dependency_*, and ui_get are OFF by default; the consolidated issue_write/sub_issue_write/update_pull_request/pull_request_review_write/add_comment_to_pending_review are ON by default.

Default-enabled label union = {SECRET, UNTRUSTED, SINK}: e.g. get_file_contents/issue_read (SECRET+UNTRUSTED) and add_issue_comment/create_issue/create_pull_request/issue_write/create_or_update_file (SINK). => UNSAFE at default with no flags.

Auth: PAT (GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN) or GitHub App or OAuth; the token can access the user's PRIVATE repos, so repo/issue/PR read tools are SECRET. The same tools can be pointed at arbitrary third-party PUBLIC repos, so they are also UNTRUSTED.
Results are passed through pkg/sanitize (HTML/invisible-char/code-fence neutralisation) and optional IFC labels, but sanitisation does not strip attacker instructions from text => UNTRUSTED stands.
Global security advisories (list/get_global_security_advisory) read the public vendor GHSA DB => no label. Repo/org security advisories are private drafts => SECRET.

Reaction/state/metadata writes (reactions, labels/assignees/milestone/type/state, branch/ref ops, subscriptions, stars, dependency links, request_reviewers, resolve/unresolve thread, delete_file, delete_repository, fork) carry no free-form agent payload to an attacker-readable place => no SINK. actions_run_trigger IS a SINK: run_workflow takes agent inputs and triggers CI that can make arbitrary outbound network calls (vendor sandbox, not HOSTEXEC).

Remote api.githubcopilot.com / ghcr.io image share this code: URL paths /, /readonly, /insiders, /readonly/insiders, /x/{toolset}[/readonly][/insiders], /x/all[...]; headers X-MCP-Toolsets, X-MCP-Tools, X-MCP-Exclude-Tools, X-MCP-Readonly, X-MCP-Lockdown, X-MCP-Insiders, X-MCP-Features; query ?features=. URL values take precedence over headers. Remote-only toolsets (copilot_spaces, github_support_docs_search) are not in this snapshot.

assign_copilot_to_issue / assign_copilot_to_issue_with_intent are labelled SINK conservatively: they dispatch the Copilot coding agent with agent-supplied custom_instructions that can drive a PR on a public repo; if that reach is considered internal-only these would drop to no-label.
